column1: # Favoured-ontology order, per annotation category. Data, not code: a curator extends this
# file without touching the assembler. Lower rank wins.
# Paul, 2026-08-18: "it's annoying showing terms which are equivalent via xrefs, if we have
# a favoured ontology (which we do)." This file is what "which we do" means, written down.
# 🛑 This is a TIE-BREAK, not the rule. It is consulted only after an ontology-declared
# obsolescence (R1) and the catalogue-class override (R2) have had their say -- see
# build_term_crossmatch.py. A preference here can never promote an obsolete term.
